results.name: Every newly generated route set contains two direct combat choices and one support choice
Levels 1 to 3 offer ordinary fights, not mandatory elite enemies
Ordinary combat cards have different terrain names
Level 4 onward can generate both elite and ordinary second routes
Elite card starts a stronger fight, not a dialogue detour
An already offered old peaceful route is not replaced on load
New route save/reload keeps terrain, choices and RNG
Ordinary victory exposes hunt, alternative route and camp controls
Continue hunting starts once and carries HP, poison and consumables forward
Pending loot blocks fast continuation until the decision is resolved
Saved victory resumes the same continuation choices without another reward
Return to camp remains available and does not force a second fight
Alternative route selection remains available after victory
Boss victory never offers unannounced ordinary continuation
Defeat, escape and peaceful story results do not become forced fights
